basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old from Huntington Beach, California, currently working as a part-time barista while pursuing my passion for digital art. I moved here last year and love the vibrant beach culture. I enjoy listening to hip-hop, especially the newer artists, though I'm still exploring the classic ones. I'm single and often spend my evenings online, between 8 PM and midnight, browsing through Reddit or playing FIFA on my Nintendo Switch. I dislike negativity and confrontation, preferring to keep things light-hearted and fun.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in digital art and new to hip-hop culture. I've been picking up bits of knowledge from online communities and friends. My understanding of music history is limited, but I'm eager to learn more.
